<ApiTitle method="post" title="Send Document for Signature" />

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/turbosign/single/prepare-for-signing"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Creates a signature document from a file, deliverable, template or URL and sends it for signature in one call. Signing emails go out in the background right after the response; set `sendEmail` to `false` when signers sign inside your app instead.

  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>
